## Description
Summary of proposed changes and technical design rationale.

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to change)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update

## Contributor Quality Checklist
- [ ] Added a changeset entry via `npm run changeset` (required for release notes)
- [ ] Unit & accessibility assertions added and passing (`npm test` / `vitest-axe`)
- [ ] Storybook story created or updated for new/modified components (`src/components/*.stories.tsx`)
- [ ] Verified Storybook static build compiles cleanly (`npm run build-storybook`)
- [ ] Updated README.md documentation if props or component APIs changed
